scenes: Can we just get used to the heat?
Up to a point, yes. | Places used to heat cope better with days of thirty to thirty-five degrees. | But beyond forty, a study of two point seven million firms found no adaptation at all.
Some heat can’t be adapted to. | Cutting emissions keeps more places below the limit.
Adapt where we can. Cut emissions so we still can.
